status.preference_level_basis: Level 2, confirmed by this paper's own build and preflights: all five systems run their pinned official code through its own main.py, with two kinds of correctness patch and dependency/environment fixes only. (1) patches/ctcdecode-cxx17.patch: ctcdecode does not compile against current PyTorch (image build im-zwwdoz4GF7RwJO4BnSPdG6). (2) patches/<repo>-ctc-without-cudnn.patch for VAC_CSLR, TLP, SEN and CorrNet: on PyTorch 2.11/cuDNN 9.19, nn.CTCLoss uses cuDNN for unequal-length batches and returns wrong gradients (cosine 0.06-0.96 vs a float64 reference; runs ctc-diagnostics-*-001, preflight-*-002/003); disabling cuDNN for the CTC call restores the native computation PyTorch 1.x used. Dependencies: lmdb (imported by TLP/SEN), simple-video-utils 0.7.4 with av 18.1.0. New datasets and Phoenix SI5 enter only as data files and dataset configs written with the repos' own preprocess helpers; no upstream code is changed for them.

metric_definitions.version: NIST SCTK sclite at commit 9688a26882a688132a5e414cadcb4c19b6fffaba (built in the Dockerfile and symlinked to each repo's ./software/sclite), invoked by each repo's evaluation/slr_eval/wer_calculation.py; the reported value is (S+D+I)/N from sclite's Sum row in the .raw report, which upstream logs to one decimal

alternatives.paper_evidence: Not excluded by the papers; selects on the test signer, so WERs are optimistically biased. Not recommended.

resolution.decision: final-epoch: each fold trains 40 epochs (steps 20/35) on every usable clip of the five training signers and scores the final-epoch (epoch 39) checkpoint on the held-out signer; no dev-based selection.
resolution.basis: Operator decision at this gate on 2026-11-02. arXiv v1 Sec. V, on CorrNet's Signer-Indep ArabSign result: 'Better results are likely to be obtained by fine-tuning the training parameters using a smaller learning rate and adopting early stopping', which indicates that no early stopping or dev-based selection was used for the leave-one-signer-out folds.
selection_procedure: Train list: every usable row of the five training signers (author train and test CSVs together), in sorted archive-path order; test list: every usable row of the held-out signer.

Upstream main.py always evaluates a dev split each epoch, so the dev list is a fixed token list that is never used for selection: the first training row of each of the 50 sentences in sorted order (these clips are also trained on; no held-out-signer clip is seen before the final scoring).
evaluate() scores the newest checkpoint and refuses to run unless it is the final epoch (num_epoch - 1).
